content:
Alex Chen: Quick notes from today's onboarding calls w/ two mid-market customers — capturing product asks and renewal risk signals. TL;DR below.
Alex Chen: Pain: invoices show per-route totals that don't match accounting -> confusion.
Alex Chen: Ask: per-route daily breakdown + CSV export for finance teams.
Alex Chen: Risk: CFO flagged unclear metering; both customers flagged renewal conversation in ~60d if we can't reconcile.
Priya Singh: Do we have an existing export for per-route billing? @Sophia Park
Sophia Park: We have per-route counters in analytics but not in the billing export. Need PM + billing eng sync to scope.
Tom Reed: Agree — product-wise a "billing audit report" CSV would reduce friction. Minimal first pass: route_id, date, tokens, cost_estimate.
Lena Morales: From CS: also request adding an onboarding checklist item — "confirm billing mapping" so AMs can surface this proactively.
Alex Chen: Suggest priority: 1) Billing audit export (high) 2) Onboarding checklist update (med) 3) UI flag for "unreconciled routes" (low). Thoughts?
Sophia Park: Thanks. I'll scope a ticket. @Tom will you pair on fields? Also include example CSV schema.
Tom Reed: `route_id,date,tokens,cost_estimate_usd,invoice_line_item`
cs-bot: Ticket created: RH-4821 'Billing audit export & onboarding checklist' — https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RH-4821
Priya Singh: Adding customer examples to the ticket — attaching their reconciled CSVs and finance notes. Tagging @Lena for enablement content.
Lena Morales: I'll draft a short checklist snippet and add to the ticket. Quick question: what cadence for export? Daily or hourly?
Sophia Park: Daily as first pass. If customers need sub-daily we'll capture requirements in RH-4821.
Alex Chen: Great. I'll follow up with the two customers about timelines and share a short AM script they can use in calls. :thumbsup:
